Default Title Error Quantity must be 1 or more Add to cart     Adding product to your cart Lola Drive is a British-Marshall-style amp-in-a-box overdrive pedal delivering the unmistakable crunch, sustain and attitude of classic Marshall JCM800 high gain valve tones. From vintage rock rhythm sounds to roaring high-gain leads, Lola brings iconic British tube amp character to any rig. 🇦🇺 HAND-BUILT in Melbourne PEDAL DETAILS "A little London attitude in a box." Some guitar tones are instantly recognisable. The roar of a pushed British valve amplifier — crunchy chords, aggressive mids, singing sustain and harmonically rich distortion — has shaped generations of rock music. Lola Drive captures that legendary Marshall British amp character in a compact pedal format, delivering everything from edge-of-breakup crunch to full-bodied overdrive with the feel and responsiveness of a driven amplifier. Designed for players chasing classic rock, hard rock and blues-rock tones, Lola provides the raw energy, dynamic response and natural compression associated with iconic British stacks. Roll back your guitar volume for cleaner vintage-style drive, or push the gain forward for thick rhythm tones and expressive lead sustain. Unlike ordinary distortion pedals, Lola focuses on amp-like response — reacting naturally to your picking attack, guitar volume and playing dynamics. It works equally well into clean amps, as a foundation drive, or stacked with other pedals for more aggressive modern tones. Whether you're chasing classic arena rock rhythms, bluesy overdrive or powerful lead tones, Lola delivers the character of a cranked British amplifier wherever you play.
